title: Ligature & Swashes Usage
slide_intent: Balance flourish with readable word shapes because decoration must support the phrase rather than compete with it.
strategic_value: Selective filled ligatures and swashes can give Burger King phrases variety while retaining a recognizable rhythm.
demonstration: Four lines of example words use outlined ordinary letters and filled special forms to isolate ligatures and swashes.
practical_value: Identify the feature in context and use one or two swashes without overlap rather than decorating every eligible letter.

ingredient.name: Selective swashes and ligatures
ingredient.role: Add balance and compact connections while maintaining legibility.
ingredient.application: Use ligatures when available; keep swashes to one or two and avoid overlap. Prefer sentence beginnings or ends, while retaining the stated flexibility.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Page 74 separately restricts swashes to word beginnings or ends. This page says the features can work in any translation. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says swashes add interest and balance and ligatures increase legibility while reducing space.
reference_purposes.Expression: The outlined words isolate the filled decorative and joined glyphs.
reference_purposes.Application: The text recommends one or two swashes and using ligatures when available.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page warns against overlap and excess; sentence beginning/end placement is explicitly not a hard rule.
